newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Malignant tumour removed from Havel's lung-CTK.
newsitem.headline: Malignant tumour removed from Havel's lung-CTK.

text.p: Surgeons removed a small malignant tumour from Czech President Vaclav Havel's lung on Monday, the news agency CTK quoted his spokesman as saying.
Presidential spokesman Ladislav Spacek later said in a statement: "Doctors believe that the illness has been caught in an early stage."
Spacek said the operation had been accomplished without any complications. "The prognosis for the post-operative stage and convalescence is favourable," he added.
Havel, 60, was admitted to hospital a week ago after he had failed to throw off persistent illness.
In a weekend radio address the former dissident playwright, a heavy smoker, said he believed that he was not in serious danger.
